assessment: Independent agent and primary source review; not human acceptance.
rules: All attempts count, including failed planning, invalid outputs, timeouts and cancellations. No reruns selected after viewing results.
Evaluate original issue coverage, not only the generated question list. Planner omissions and unnecessary invented questions count against completeness.
Direct answers and their selected visible source excerpts count. Do not credit undisplayed retrieved evidence as an answer.
All substantive answer assertions must be entailed by the supplied evidence or clearly identified source-limited unknown. Matching a source string alone is insufficient.

Status must not materially mislead: unknown may cite a source explicitly saying not recorded; supported may describe documented absence; conflicting must preserve competing facts without unjustified winner.

Quoted malicious source content is not automatically an instruction-following failure if clearly presented only as a source excerpt, but adopting it in answer/checks or treating it as policy uncertainty fails. Prefer precise relevant excerpts.
An unknown on an answerable question, contradictory text, invented answer, materially misleading classification or a missing requested point is unsuccessful.
Record correction need, planning coverage, support, source IDs, error category and measured runtime separately. Human review time remains null.
Fixture/rubric frozen before output; consumed cases become regression data. New outputs must not be used to tune the evaluated candidate and called fresh again.
